explication: HCL is a Go toolkit for defining structured configuration languages. The principal workflow is an application supplying configuration text, parsing it as native HCL or HCL JSON, then decoding its attributes and blocks into application values; native expressions can also use application-provided variables and functions. The map includes declarative and struct decoders, dynamic-block and expression extensions, plus source-preserving writing and formatting. Edges follow README statements and shown imports or calls; unsampled subsystem links are omitted rather than inferred.
